description: The entry point before working on any project: returns its Capsule (the compressed must-remember summary) plus the read-next list for deeper context, and lists any decisions or rules that are superseded or expired so you do not act on them. Query by project name, id, or a trigger word. Read-only; when nothing matches, the error lists the projects that exist.
